correctness.rationale: A simple-root-coordinate proof shows the long-short alternating spine and comparability equivalences with every short root. Any occurring profile fixes all but exactly one long-root membership and yields exactly two full-ideal extensions. The established Coxeter-Catalan count and two-adic binomial valuation imply all powers-of-two Walsh multipliers are 2 mod 4. Two independent exhaustive integer algorithms corroborate ranks 2-5; a direct rank-six cancellation is 462 minus 462; no finite extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: The closest root-poset enumeration, Panyushev 2003, already counts short antichains and describes shifted Ferrers ideals; those facts are explicitly attributed as prior. Its inspected sections do not state the uniform fibre for projection of all full ideals or signed Fourier invertibility, while related type-C bijection and arrangement works treat different observables. Record searches did not surface an equivalent result; an implicit derivation from classical shifted Ferrers theory remains a real priority risk.

value.rationale: Short-root restriction is a canonical loss of long-root observables in nonsimply-laced type C. The all-rank uniform lift is structural and yields an infinite power-of-two nonvanishing Fourier class; sharp small-rank census and rank-six witness prove reentrant recoverability not supplied by root-ideal counts alone. The claim deliberately does not overstate the unknown converse.
